info.title: Good to know
info.i1.d: It is the phase that comes before and around menopause. Hormonal changes can bring different symptoms over time.
info.i2.d: No two perimenopauses are alike. That is why you choose what to track, for how many days and at what time of day.
info.i3.t: Your entries give a voice to what you feel
info.i3.d: A summary of the period supports the conversation with your health professional. The Lunera App does not replace a clinical assessment.
msg.start: You are starting a kind of care that respects your pace. What you feel matters and deserves to be heard. Your entries can support the conversation with your health professional and help you understand the changes in your body.
msg.midOk: You are doing really well. Your entries are helping to build your care story. Shall we keep going, one day at a time?
msg.midPending: Some entries were left open, and it is fine to pick up from where you are. This tracking may show only part of what you lived. Don’t give up on your care: bring what you managed to log and talk about the gaps with your professional.
msg.end: Congratulations on dedicating this time to your health. You have reached the end of this period. Your entries, including the days that were harder to log, can help in your next conversation. Keep taking care of yourself.

evo.title: Progress
evo.lead: A simple reading of what you logged.
evo.srcNote.mine: Showing only what you logged on this device.
evo.srcNote.example: Synthetic example data. It does not come from you or from any real person.
evo.empty: There are not enough entries for a summary yet. With three logged days it will appear here.
evo.synth: {{name}}: {{trend}} between the first and the second half of the period, with {{k}} logged days out of {{n}}. Gaps: {{gaps}}. This describes your own reports; it is not a diagnosis.
evo.scaleLegend: 0 Didn’t feel it · 1 Mild · 2 Moderate · 3 Strong · 4 Very strong. Light bands are days without an entry.
evo.patchLead: Sync the patch to compare your diary with its signals over the same time window.
evo.cHot: Hot flashes: reports and candidate events from the patch
evo.noHot: Hot flashes are not in your plan, so there is no report to compare.
evo.corr: Association in the example data (Pearson): r = {{r}}, with {{n}} pairs over {{d}} days. Association does not mean agreement, cause, diagnosis or sensor validation.
evo.corrMine: The correlation is not calculated with your entries in this demo, because the patch signals are synthetic.
evo.corrNone: Not enough pairs to calculate an association.

x3.title: 3D experience
x3.boxLead: It all starts here: the Lunera Patch, ready to accompany you.
x3.l1.d: Protects the electronics. Shape and sealing still under evaluation.
x3.l2.d: Movement (sleep), heart rate, skin temperature and skin conductance, which help assess hot flashes.
x3.l3.d: Keeps the patch in place: on the breastbone, below the breast or on the back.
x3.illus: Conceptual model, without validated dimensions. Structural illustration, not a manufacturing design.
